disposition: Request one full NLP solve on the refined two-step grid at frozen design d=0, objective task_gap with default weights (position 1.0, speed 1.0, secondary 0.0), initialization saved_schedule from artifact 6f121f12...; evaluate with the standard independent BDF replay and report original (unsoftened) metrics plus slacks for the revision/STOP decision.
fixed_conditions: Frozen: target [0.29,0.035,0.19] m, mount [0,0,0.15] with identity quaternion, gravity -9.81 m/s^2, duration 0.35 s with 35 control intervals at 0.01 s (physical timestep 0.0005 s, 24 mesh cells), named zero initial positions and velocities (hard), existing two-segment topology with six ideal tension channels, guides, rigid components and payload, existing material/sections and structural_linear basis, tension bounds [0,8] N hard, constant design throughout the trajectory within d in [-1,1], nonnegative shared position/speed slacks as the only relaxation, exact automatic AD for outer derivatives, local reverse derivatives retained. No physical launches; no integrator substitution; no controller search; no change to task, material, topology or horizon.
hypothesis: The dominant residual in the historical corrected-A iterate is discretization error of the original 0.01 s integration grid, not the slack weights or the design value. Diagnose shows saved-NLP vs tightly-solved-original-grid agreement to 5.9e-7 m / 1.3e-5 m/s (so the saved schedule is a genuine original-grid optimum), while tightly-solved original vs tightly-solved two-step refined grid disagrees by 3.74 mm tip and 0.0467 m/s — far beyond the 1 mm / 0.002 m/s refinement gate. Therefore solving the SAME frozen-design (d=0) two-shared-slack gap problem on the refined grid (substeps=2, 0.005 s), warm-started from the diagnosed original-grid iterate (artifact 6f121f12... /candidate/states, 36 nodes, d=0.0, pretension_0_2, iteration 59), should move the returned iterate onto the refined physics and shrink the original-grid residual below the holding/terminal limits while keeping slacks the only relaxation.
limitations: No physical validation: zero physical launches authorized, so no claim of real-hardware task success.
Design is frozen at the historical d=0 in this batch (design_bounds [0,0]), so no joint design/control conclusion can be drawn and corrected_B's worse d=0.767 point is not re-tested.
substeps=2 is a single two-step grid refinement, not a grid-convergence study; agreement at 0.005 s does not establish convergence.
Weights are kept at the default [1,1]; cross-weight comparison of original metrics is deferred to a single possible revision.
Replay-limit agreement is a numerical consistency check on one integrator, not physical truth; slacks are search-only and a relaxed feasible iterate is not task success.
One seed (17) and one initialization path; the warm start may bias iteration count and the located local solution.
Historical 'optimal reported' terminations were on relaxed formulations and previously failed to export vectors, so refinement was not yet demonstrated empirically.
revision_or_stop_rule: After consuming the batch feedback and the independent BDF replay of any usable returned schedule: (a) if a usable schedule is returned whose replay agrees within 1 mm / 0.002 m/s and whose ORIGINAL unsoftened metrics satisfy holding and terminal 0.01 m and holding 0.02 m/s limits, STOP with that as the bounded numerical result (noting the residual normalization gate and slack values); (b) if the refined solve returns a usable schedule that still misses the unsoftened limits, spend the single revision solve on the supported lever the feedback most implicates — changed slack weights within [0.25,4] to expose which of position/speed carries the residual, or the saved schedule as a fresh initialization — never on extra solves; (c) if the batch returns only failures/unusable output, interpret honestly and either STOP or take one repair-free revision within budget; (d) if a third question about a NEW candidate arises, use at most one diagnostic replay, otherwise STOP.
weakening_observation: No trustworthy feasible schedule exists yet at any design point. Corrected_A (d=0) is a mathematical infeasible_returned_iterate: holding_max_speed 0.02208 m/s exceeds the 0.02 m/s holding limit while holding/terminal position errors (0.009818/0.009812 m) sit just under the 0.01 m limit, normalized_violation 0.21872. Corrected_B (d=0.767) is worse (violation 0.73626). The independent BDF replay of the saved schedule disagrees with its own NLP by 8.1 mm tip and 0.0997 m/s holding speed, far outside the 1 mm / 0.002 m/s replay limit, and the diagnose precision check (saved vs precision BDF: 6.3e-12 m, 4.7e-10 m/s) shows that disagreement is a discretization/model-consistency effect rather than BDF tolerance error. Historical refined solves also terminated at relaxed 'optimal' reports with unexported vectors, so refinement alone is not yet demonstrated to purchase feasibility.
